messages:
Ava: morning team — Maplecrest day0 handoff. Need quick confirm on three things: 1) KMS key policy + scheduled rotation, 2) cross-account IAM role for log forwarding, 3) egress firewall rule for splunk collector. @Jorge @Mira
Jorge: noted. For KMS, they want auto-rotation every 90 days — we usually recommend annual for CMKs but customer wants 90. Need security signoff. cc @Mira
Mira: 90-day rotation is fine if they manage key material via our CMK integration and we enable a key policy that restricts Decrypt to their VPC endpoint. Will share sample policy.
Mira: ```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/Redwood-PrivForwarder"},
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*"],
      "Resource": "*",
      "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"kms:ViaService": "s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com"}}
    }
  ]
}
```
Jorge: For cross-account IAM, we recommend a role with a narrow assume-role trust: `sts:AssumeRole` from their log-shipper account only. Sample trust: 
Jorge: ```json
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::998877665544:root"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRole"}]
}
```
Sam: Network note — splunk collector IPs 52.23.11.0/28 need egress and we need to open 443 outbound only. Also request for NAT gateway audit logs to be forwarded to their SIEM. They asked about log retention (1 year) and whether shipper uses TLS mutual auth.
Ava: cc customer rep via email. Renewal risk flag: if day0 shows more than 2 blockers on infra side we escalate for a one-off eng-hours credit. Please capture blockers here.
Mira: I’ll sign off on KMS policy if they add the VPC endpoint condition and tag enforcement. Also ask them to confirm CMK alias naming convention so rotation scripts can find keys.
Jorge: action items:
- Jorge: send role/trust docs + terraform snippet (ETA today EOD)
- Mira: produce sanitized KMS policy + sample tag enforcement (ETA tomorrow)
- Sam: confirm collector IPs with infra team + share firewall change request template (ETA today)
- Ava: schedule 1:1 enablement with Maplecrest onboarding lead for Thursday 10am PT
Ava: quick FYI — ops-bot created a runbook page: https://redwood.company/runbooks/maplecrest-onboard
ops-bot: Deployment checklist updated — KMS rotation toggle: ENABLED, NAT logging: PENDING, Firewall change: OPEN
maple-ops: thanks for the fast replies — small ask: can you confirm whether audit logs will be delivered to our S3 bucket with SSE-KMS? we want server-side encryption with customer-managed CMK.
Mira: yes — we can push to S3 with SSE-KMS using their CMK. Need bucket ARN and kms key ARN. Also confirm role permission `s3:PutObject` + kms permissions.
Ava: noted. Capturing feedback for post-onboard survey: speed of setup, clarity of runbooks, handoff responsiveness. Please add any items.
Sam: Logging note: we'll include a sample CloudTrail filter we used for other customers, will paste in channel after EOD.
Jorge: terraform snippet for assume role:
Jorge: ```hcl
resource "aws_iam_role" "redwood_forwarder" {
  name = "redwood-forwarder"
  assume_role_policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [{
      Effect = "Allow"
      Principal = { AWS = "arn:aws:iam::998877665544:root" }
      Action = "sts:AssumeRole"
    }]
  })
}
```
Ava: leaving this thread open — if anything stalls ping me directly. thanks team :thumbsup:
